name: input-lock
title: Input Lock
description: Lock the keyboard and trackpad, and unlock only by typing a secret key sequence.
author: dharun

commands.name: lock
commands.title: Lock Keyboard & Trackpad
commands.subtitle: Input Lock
commands.description: Block all keyboard and trackpad input until the unlock sequence is typed.

preferences.name: blockTrackpad
preferences.title: Pointer
preferences.label: Also block trackpad & mouse
preferences.description: Freeze the cursor and swallow clicks, scrolls and gestures.

commands.name: lock-keyboard
commands.title: Lock Keyboard Only
commands.subtitle: Input Lock
commands.description: Block keyboard input but keep the trackpad working — handy for wiping the keys.

preferences.name: unlockSequence
preferences.title: Unlock Sequence
preferences.description: Type these characters (case-insensitive, at least 3) while locked to unlock. Only the sequence matters — other keys typed before it are ignored.

preferences.name: autoUnlockMinutes
preferences.title: Auto-Unlock After (minutes)
preferences.description: Safety net in case you forget the sequence. 0 disables it. Override per lock with the duration argument (e.g. 5m, 90s, 1h30m).

preferences.name: showOverlay
preferences.title: Overlay
preferences.label: Show lock overlay
preferences.description: Show a small on-screen panel while locked, with progress dots as you type the sequence.

preferences.name: playUnlockSound
preferences.title: Unlock Feedback
preferences.label: Play a sound when unlocked
preferences.description: Play the Glass sound and briefly show an "Unlocked" confirmation when input is restored.
